# llmstxt

Generate an llms.txt index and Markdown copies of selected pages. Native support was added in Zensical **0.0.67**.

Give language-model tools an index of a documentation set; provide one full-text file for offline ingestion.

## Try it

[Open the llmstxt example](/zensical-examples/variants/llmstxt/).

### Index

Open `llms.txt` for named links to selected Markdown pages.

### Full text

Open `llms-full.txt` to inspect the selected pages combined in one file.

[llms.txt index](/zensical-examples/variants/llmstxt/llms.txt) · [Combined text](/zensical-examples/variants/llmstxt/llms-full.txt) · [Field notes as Markdown](https://pete-wai.github.io/zensical-examples/variants/llmstxt/notes/index.md)
